description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'makeOpenAIResponsesRequest' that interacts with the OpenAI API to send messages, handle streaming responses, manage MCP and code interpreter tools, and process various response events including text deltas, MCP events, reasoning, and usage data.

methods.name: makeOpenAIResponsesRequest
methods.description: Sends a streaming request to the OpenAI API with specified messages and options, handles response events including MCP, code interpreter, text deltas, reasoning, and usage, and invokes callback functions accordingly.
